# 1.2.37 - an empty tile is glass

The notice tile has been part of the curtain's shape since 1.2.36, which left
it a dark plate between notices - and the GM bar's pane the same on a player's
screen. A pane cut for a block that is not there keeps its place in the
partition but is painted like the filler around it now: the same black glass,
the same one-in-four chance of a coloured pane, breathing with the rest. The
moment a card lands on it, it takes the notice tone again.

Two tests join the suite: "the theme speaks two faces" (every module surface
resolves to VT323 or Special Elite, icons excepted) and "the notice tile is
always cut".
